name: brane
description: Monorepo root for Cloudflare Pages. Option A (recommended): Root directory = repo root, Build command = npm run build, Build output = frontend/build. Option B: Root directory = frontend, Build command = npm run build, Build output = build.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix ./frontend --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix ./frontend && npm run build:engine
scripts.build:engine: cd branpy-game-engine && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build && node -e "var fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');var s='dist',d='../frontend/build/engine';if(!fs.existsSync(s)){console.error('engine dist missing');process.exit(1)};function cpR(src,dst){fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(function(f){var sp=p.join(src,f),dp=p.join(dst,f);fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory()?cpR(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)})};if(fs.existsSync(d)){fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})}cpR(s,d);console.log('Engine copied to '+d);"
